title: 100% Uptime Guarantee
facebook_comment_text: 💡 Beyond immediate revenue loss, that 10-minute blip can silently erode customer trust, trigger compliance penalties, and halt critical internal operations. Our zero-trust containers are engineered for proactive resilience, not just reactive scaling. 🤔 For fellow tech leaders, what's one *non-obvious* impact of even brief downtime you've encountered in your experience?
